s.d: Ταβειθά (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא), Tabitha: [[acts 9 36|Act.9:36, 40]] (cf. Δορκάς).† (AS)

τάγμα, -τος, τό (τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;] that which has been arranged or placed in order; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank: metaphorically, [[1-corinthians 15 23|1Co.15:23]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)
τακτός, -ή, -όν (τάσσω), [in LXX: [[job 12 5|Job.12:5]] (שַׁאֲנָן) * ;] ordered, fixed, stated: ἡμέρα, [[acts 12 21|Act.12:21]],† (AS)

ταλαιπωρέω, -ῶ (ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;] 1. to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress: [[james 4 9|Jas.4:9.]] 2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so [[psalms 17 9|Psa.17:9]], [[isaiah 33 1|Isa.33:1]]).† (AS)

ταλαιπωρία, -ας, ἡ (ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;] 1. hard work (Hippocr.). 2. hardship, suffering, distress: [[romans 3 16|Rom.3:16]] (LXX) pl., [[james 5 1|Jas.5:1]] (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153). (Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)† (AS)

ταλαίωρος, -ον [in LXX: [[psalms 137 8|Psa.137:8]] (שָׁדַד), [[isaiah 33 1|Isa.33:1]] (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10, Wis.3:11, al. ;] distressed, miserable, wretched: [[romans 7 24|Rom.7:24]], [[revelation 3 17|Rev.3:17]].† (AS)
ταλαντιαῖος, -α, -ον (τάλαντον), (a) worth a talent; (b) of a talent's weight: [[revelation 16 21|Rev.16:21.]]† (AS)

τάλαντομ, -ον, τ [in LXX for כִּכָּר ;] 1. a balance (Hom.). 2. that which is weighed, a talent; (a) a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold); (b) a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight (see DB, iii, 418 ff.): [[matthew 18 24|Mat.18:24 25:15]] ff.† (AS)
ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr., 150), talitha, i.e. maiden: [[mark 5 41|Mrk.5:41.]]† (AS)

ταμεῖον (late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr., 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;] 1. a treasury (Thuc., al). 2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; [[deuteronomy 28 8|Deu.28:8]]): [[luke 12 24|Luk.12:24]]. 3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 [[isaiah 26 20|Isa.26:20]], al.): [[matthew 6 6|Mat.6:6 24:26]], [[luke 12 3|Luk.12:3]].† (AS)

τάξις, -εως, ἡ (τάσσω), [in LXX: [[job 38 12|Job.38:12]] (מָקוֹם), [[psalms 110 4|Psa.110:4]] (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18, al. ;] 1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.). 2. arrangement, order (Plat., al): [[luke 1 8|Luk.1:8.]] 3. due order: [[colossians 2 5|Col.2:5]] (ICC, in l); κατὰ τάξιν, [[1-corinthians 14 40|1Co.14:40.]] 4. office, order (for exx., see MM, xxiv): [[hebrews 5 6|Heb.5:6]] (LXX), [[hebrews 5 6|Heb.5:6 6:20 7:11, 17]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

ταπεινός, -ή, -όν [in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;] low-lying; metaphorically, (a) lowly, of low degree, brought low: [[james 1 9|Jas.1:9]], [[2-corinthians 7 6|2Co.7:6]] (cf. Sir.25:23); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, [[luke 1 52|Luk.1:52;]] τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC, in l), [[romans 12 16|Rom.12:16;]] (b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., Syn., § xlii; but see also Abbott, Essays, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: [[2-corinthians 10 1|2Co.10:1;]] before τ. καρδίᾳ, [[matthew 11 29|Mat.11:29]] (cf. [[psalms 34 19|Psa.34:19]]); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, [[james 4 6|Jas.4:6]], [[1-peter 5 5|1Pe.5:5]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

ταπεινοφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ (ταπεινόφρων) lowliness of mind, humility: [[acts 20 19|Act.20:19]], [[ephesians 4 2|Eph.4:2]], [[philippians 2 3|Php.2:3]], [[colossians 3 12|Col.3:12]], [[1-peter 5 5|1Pe.5:5]]; of a false humility, [[colossians 2 18|Col.2:18, 23]] (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn., § xlii).† (AS)

ταπεινόω, -ῶ (ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;] to make low: ὄρος (βουνόν), [[luke 3 5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase: [[matthew 18 4|Mat.18:4 23:12]], [[luke 14 11|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[2-corinthians 11 7|2Co.11:7 12:21]], [[philippians 2 8|Php.2:8]]; pass., [[matthew 23 12|Mat.23:12]], [[luke 14 11|Luk.14:11 18:14]], [[philippians 4 12|Php.4:12]]; id. with mid. sense, [[james 4 10|Jas.4:10]], [[1-peter 5 6|1Pe.5:6]].† (AS)

ταπείνωσις, -εως, ἡ (ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;] abasement, humiliation, low estate: [[luke 1 48|Luk.1:48]], [[acts 8 33|Act.8:33]]" (LXX), [[philippians 3 21|Php.3:21]], [[james 1 10|Jas.1:10]] (Plat., Arist., and later writers).† (AS)

ταράσσω [in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;] to disturb, trouble, stir up: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, [[john 1 5|Jhn.1:5]] [4], [[john 1 7|Jhn.1:7.]] Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex: [[acts 15 24|Act.15:24]], [[galatians 1 7|Gal.1:7 5:10]]; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), [[john 11 33|Jhn.11:33;]] of a crowd, to stir up, [[acts 17 8|Act.17:8, 13]]; pass., [[matthew 2 3|Mat.2:3 14:26]], [[mark 6 50|Mrk.6:50]], [[luke 1 12|Luk.1:12 24:38]], [[john 12 27|Jhn.12:27]] ([[psalms 6 4|Psa.6:4]]) [[psalms 14 1|Psa.14:1]], 7, [[1-peter 3 14|1Pe.3:14]]" (LXX) ; τ. πνεύματι, [[john 13 21|Jhn.13:21]] (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω) (AS)
ταραχή, -ῆς, ἡ (ταράσσω), [in LXX for חָלָה, מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] trouble, disturbance: τ. ὕδατος, [[john 1 5|Jhn.1:5]] [4]. In pl. (as in cl.), tumults: [[mark 13 8|Mrk.13:8]], Rec.† (AS)
τάραχος, -ου, ὁ (ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;] later form of ταραχή (Xen., al.; see Thackeray, Gr., 159): [[acts 12 18|Act.12:18 19:23]].† (AS)
Ταρσεύς, -έως, ὁ (Ταρσός), of Tarsus: [[acts 9 11|Act.9:11 21:39]].† (AS)
Ταρσός, -oῦ Tarsus, a city of Cilicia: [[acts 9 30|Act.9:30 11:25 22:3]].† (AS)
ταρταρόω, -ῶ (Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned), to cast into hell: [[2-peter 2 4|2Pe.2:4]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

τάσσω [in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;] primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order: with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), [[acts 15 2|Act.15:2 18:2]] (διατ-, WH) [[acts 22 10|Act.22:10;]] ἑαυτούς, [[1-corinthians 16 15|1Co.16:15;]] pass., [[matthew 8 9|Mat.8:9]] (T [WH], R, txt., om.), [[luke 7 8|Luk.7:8]], [[romans 13 1|Rom.13:1]]; ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον (perh. in mid. sense; see EGT and Page, in l), [[acts 13 48|Act.13:48;]] mid., to appoint for oneself or by one's own authority, [[matthew 28 16|Mat.28:16]], [[acts 28 23|Act.28:23]].† (AS)
ταῦρος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹר ;] a bull: [[matthew 22 4|Mat.22:4]], [[acts 14 13|Act.14:13]], [[hebrews 9 13|Heb.9:13 10:4]].† (AS)

οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο, genitive, τούτου, ταύτης, τούτου, [in LXX chiefly for זֹאת ,זֶה ;] demonstr. pron. (related to ἐκεῖνος as hic to ille), this; 1. as subst., this one, he; (a) absol.: [[matthew 3 17|Mat.3:17]], [[mark 9 7|Mrk.9:7]], [[luke 7 44|Luk.7:44, 45]], [[john 1 15|Jhn.1:15]], [[acts 2 15|Act.2:15]], al.; expressing contempt (cl.), [[matthew 13 55|Mat.13:55, 56]], [[mark 6 2|Mrk.6:2]], 3, [[john 6 42|Jhn.6:42]], al.; εἰς τοῦτο, [[mark 1 38|Mrk.1:38]], [[romans 14 9|Rom.14:9]]; μετὰ τοῦτο (ταῦτα; V. Westc. on [[john 5 1|Jhn.5:1]]), [[john 2 12|Jhn.2:12 11:7]], al.; (b) epanaleptic (referring to what precedes): [[matthew 5 19|Mat.5:19]], [[mark 3 35|Mrk.3:35]], [[luke 9 48|Luk.9:48]], [[john 6 46|Jhn.6:46]], [[romans 7 10|Rom.7:10]], al.; (with) proleptic (referring to what follows): before ἵνα (Bl., §69, 6), [[luke 1 43|Luk.1:43]], [[john 3 19|Jhn.3:19]] (and freq.) 15:8, [[romans 14 9|Rom.14:9]], al.; before ὅτι, [[luke 10 11|Luk.10:11]], [[john 9 3|Jhn.9:3]]o, [[acts 24 14|Act.24:14]], [[romans 2 3|Rom.2:3]], al.; ὅπως, [[romans 9 17|Rom.9:17;]] ἐάν, [[john 13 35|Jhn.13:35;]] (d) special idioms: τοῦτο μὲν . . . τ. δέ (cl), partly . . . partly. [[hebrews 10 33|Heb.10:33;]] καὶ τοῦτο (τοῦτον, ταῦτα), and that (him) too, [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]], [[1-corinthians 2 2|1Co.2:2]], [[hebrews 11 12|Heb.11:12]]; τοῦτ᾽ ἐστιν, [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46.]] 2. As adj., with subst.; (a) with art. (α) before the art.: [[matthew 12 32|Mat.12:32]], [[mark 9 29|Mrk.9:29]], [[luke 7 44|Luk.7:44]], [[john 4 15|Jhn.4:15]], [[romans 11 24|Rom.11:24]], [[revelation 19 9|Rev.19:9]], al.; (β) after the noun: [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[mark 12 16|Mrk.12:16]], [[luke 11 31|Luk.11:31]], [[john 4 13|Jhn.4:13]], [[acts 6 13|Act.6:13]], [[romans 15 28|Rom.15:28]], [[1-corinthians 1 20|1Co.1:20]], [[revelation 2 24|Rev.2:24]], al.; (b) with subst. anarth. (with predicative force; Bl., §49, 4): [[luke 1 36|Luk.1:36 2:2 24:21]], [[john 2 11|Jhn.2:11 4:54 21:14]], [[2-corinthians 13 1|2Co.13:1]]. (AS)
thus, in the same way
hence, (to or with or by, etc.) these
- (towards or of) this
ταφή, -ῆς, ἡ (θάπτω), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַר and cognate forms ;] burial: [[matthew 27 7|Mat.27:7]] (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).† (AS)

τάφος, -ου, ὁ (θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;] 1. a burial (Hom., al.). 2. a grave, tomb (Res., Hdt., al.): [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1]], [[romans 3 13|Rom.3:13]]" (LXX) .† (AS)
τάχα (ταχύς), adv., [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;] (a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently; (b) perhaps: [[romans 5 7|Rom.5:7]], Phm 15.† (AS)

ταχέως (ταχύς) adv., [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;] quickly, hastily: [[luke 14 21|Luk.14:21 16:6]], [[john 11 31|Jhn.11:31]], [[1-corinthians 4 19|1Co.4:19]], [[philippians 2 19|Php.2:19, 24]], [[2-timothy 4 9|2Ti.4:9]]; with suggestion of rashness, [[galatians 1 6|Gal.1:6]], [[2-thessalonians 2 2|2Th.2:2]], [[1-timothy 5 22|1Ti.5:22]].† (AS)

ταχινός, -ή, -όν [in LXX: [[proverbs 1 16|Pro.1:16]], [[habakkuk 1 6|Hab.1:6]], [[isaiah 59 7|Isa.59:7]] (מָהַר), Wis.13:2, Sir.11:22 18:26 * ;] poët. and late for ταχύς, swift: of swift approach, [[2-peter 1 14|2Pe.1:14 2:1]].† (AS)

τάχειον, see: ταχύ. ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς), adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quickly, speedily, forthwith: [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[mark 9 39|Mrk.9:39]], [[luke 15 22|Luk.15:22]], [[john 11 29|Jhn.11:29]], [[revelation 2 16|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[john 13 27|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[1-timothy 3 14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[hebrews 13 19|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15.]]† (AS)

τάχιστα, see: ταχύ. ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς), adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quickly, speedily, forthwith: [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[mark 9 39|Mrk.9:39]], [[luke 15 22|Luk.15:22]], [[john 11 29|Jhn.11:29]], [[revelation 2 16|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[john 13 27|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[1-timothy 3 14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[hebrews 13 19|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15.]]† (AS)

τάχος, -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of מָהַר ;] swiftness, speed. Adverbially, ἐν τ. (ταχέως), quickly, speedily, soon: [[luke 18 8|Luk.18:8]], [[acts 12 7|Act.12:7 22:18 25:4]], [[romans 16 20|Rom.16:20]], [[1-timothy 3 14|1Ti.3:14]], [[revelation 1 1|Rev.1:1 22:6]].† (AS)

ταχύ (neut. of ταχύς), adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quickly, speedily, forthwith: [[matthew 5 25|Mat.5:25 28:7-8]], [[mark 9 39|Mrk.9:39]], [[luke 15 22|Luk.15:22]], [[john 11 29|Jhn.11:29]], [[revelation 2 16|Rev.2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[john 13 27|Jhn.13:27 20:4]], [[1-timothy 3 14|1Ti.3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[hebrews 13 19|Heb.13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15.]]† (AS)
ταχύς, -εῖα, -ύ [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;] quick, swift, speedy: opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.† (AS)

τέ, enclitic copulative particle (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in Ac. 1. τέ solitarium, and, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): [[matthew 28 12|Mat.28:12]], [[john 4 42|Jhn.4:42]], [[acts 2 33|Act.2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21]], al. 2. Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ . . . καί, τὲ καί, τὲ . . . τέ ([[acts 26 16|Act.26:16]] [[romans 14 8|Rom.14:8]]), as well . . . as also, both . . . and: [[luke 12 45|Luk.12:45]], [[acts 1 1|Act.1:1 15:9, 21:30]], al.; τὲ . . . δέ, and . . . and, [[acts 19 2|Act.19:2;]] τὲ γάρ . . . ὁμοίως δὲ καί, [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26, 27]]. (AS)

τεῖχος, -ους, τό [in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;] a wall, esp. that about a town: [[acts 9 25|Act.9:25]], [[2-corinthians 11 33|2Co.11:33]], [[hebrews 11 30|Heb.11:30]], [[revelation 21 12|Rev.21:12-19]] † (AS)
τεκμήριον, -ου, τό (τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: Wis.5:4 19:13, 3Ma.3:24 * ;] a sure sign, a positive proof: [[acts 1 1|Act.1:1-26]] (for exx., see MM, xxiv).† SYN.: ἔνδειγμα, q.v (AS)

τεκνίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of τέκνον), a little child: as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., [[john 13 33|Jhn.13:33]], [[galatians 4 19|Gal.4:19]], [[1-john 2 1|1Jn.2:1]] [[john 2 12|Jn 2:12]] [[john 2 28|Jn 2:28]] [[john 3 7|Jn 3:7]] [[john 3 13|Jn 3:13]] [[john 4 4|Jn 4:4]] [[john 5 21|Jn 5:21]].† (AS)
τεκνογονέω, -ῶ to beget or bear children: [[1-timothy 5 14|1Ti.5:14]] (Anthol.).† (AS)
τεκνογονία, -ας, ἡ, child-bearing: [[1-timothy 2 15|1Ti.2:15]] (Arist.).† (AS)

τέκνον, -ου, τό (τίκτω), [in LXX chiefly for בֵּן, also for יֶלֶד, etc. ;] that which is begotten, born (cf. Scottish bairn), a child of either sex: [[mark 13 12|Mrk.13:12]], [[luke 1 7|Luk.1:7]], [[acts 7 5|Act.7:5]]; pl., [[matthew 7 11|Mat.7:11]], [[mark 7 27|Mrk.7:27]], [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17]], [[ephesians 6 1|Eph.6:1]], al.; τέκνα ἐπαγγελίας, [[romans 9 8|Rom.9:8;]] τ. τῆς σαρκός, ib.; in a wider sense (as Heb. בָּנִים), of posterity, [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8]], al.; specif., of a male child, [[matthew 21 28|Mat.21:28]], [[acts 21 21|Act.21:21]], a,l.; in voc. as a form of kindly address from an elder to a junior or from a teacher to a disciple, [[matthew 9 2|Mat.9:2 21:28]], [[mark 2 5|Mrk.2:5]], [[luke 2 48|Luk.2:48]]; τ. μου (= cl. τ. μοι; see Bl., §37, 5), [[galatians 4 19|Gal.4:19]] (τεκνία, WH, txt.), [[2-timothy 2 1|2Ti.2:1.]] Metaphorical, (a) of disciples (apart from direct address, see supr.): Phm 10, [[1-timothy 1 2|1Ti.1:2]], [[titus 1 4|Tit.1:4]], 3Jo.4; (b) with reference to the Fatherhood of God (see: πατήρ, γεννάω), τέκνα τ. θεοῦ (cf. [[isaiah 30 1|Isa.30:1]], Wis.16:21): [[romans 8 16|Rom.8:16]], [[ephesians 5 1|Eph.5:1]], [[philippians 2 15|Php.2:15]]; and esp. in Johannine bks. (cf. Westc, Epp. Jo., 94, 120), [[john 1 12|Jhn.1:12]], [[1-john 3 1|1Jn.3:1]] al.; (with) of those who imitate others and are therefore regarded as the spiritual offspring of their exemplars: [[matthew 3 9|Mat.3:9]], [[luke 3 8|Luk.3:8]], [[john 8 39|Jhn.8:39]], [[romans 9 7|Rom.9:7]], [[1-peter 3 6|1Pe.3:6]]; τ. διαβόλου, [[1-john 3 10|1Jn.3:10;]] (d) as in Heb. (LXX, [[joel 2 23|Jol.2:23]], [[psalms 149 2|Psa.149:2]], 1Ma.1:38), of the inhabitants of a city: [[matthew 23 37|Mat.23:37]], [[luke 13 34|Luk.13:34 19:44]], [[galatians 4 25|Gal.4:25]]; (e) with an adjectival genitive, frequently rendering a Heb. expression, adopted from LXX or formed on the analogy of its language, but sometimes with parallels in Gk. writers (see Deiss., BS, 161ff.): τέκνα φωτός, [[ephesians 5 8|Eph.5:8;]] τ. ὑπακοῆς, [[1-peter 1 14|1Pe.1:14;]] κατάρας, [[2-peter 2 14|2Pe.2:14;]] ὀργῆς, [[ephesians 2 3|Eph.2:3.]] SYN.: see: παῖς. (AS)
τεκνο-τροφέω, -ῶ to rear young (of bees, Arist.), to bring up children: [[1-timothy 5 10|1Ti.5:10.]]† (AS)
τέκτων, -ονος, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;] an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): [[matthew 13 55|Mat.13:55]], [[mark 6 3|Mrk.6:3]].† (AS)

τέλειος, -α, -ον (τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;] having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect; 1. of persons, primarily of physical development, (a) full-grown, mature: [[hebrews 5 14|Heb.5:14;]] ethically: [[philippians 3 15|Php.3:15;]] opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), [[1-corinthians 2 6|1Co.2:6 14:20]], [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]]; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, [[colossians 4 12|Col.4:12;]] τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, [[colossians 1 28|Col.1:28;]] (b) complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on [[james 1 4|Jas.1:4]]): [[matthew 5 48|Mat.5:48 19:21]], [[james 1 4|Jas.1:4 3:2]]; of God, [[matthew 5 48|Mat.5:48.]] 2. Of things, complete, perfect: [[romans 12 2|Rom.12:2;]] ἔργον, [[james 1 4|Jas.1:4;]] νόμος, [[james 1 25|Jas.1:25;]] δώρημα, [[james 1 17|Jas.1:17;]] ἀγάπη, [[1-john 4 18|1Jn.4:18;]] τὸ τ., [[1-corinthians 13 10|1Co.13:10;]] compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), [[hebrews 9 11|Heb.9:11.]] (There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. ICC on [[colossians 1 28|Col.1:28;]] but see also Lft., in l, and Notes, 173 f.) † SYN.: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.) (AS)

τελειότης, -ητος, ἡ (τέλειος), [in LXX: [[judges 9 16|Jdg.9:16, 19]] (תָּמִים), [[proverbs 11 3|Pro.11:3]] (תֻּמָּה), Wis.6:15 12:17, [[jeremiah 2 2|Jer.2:2]] * ;] perfection, completeness: [[colossians 3 14|Col.3:14]], [[hebrews 6 1|Heb.6:1]] (AS)

τελειόω, -ῶ (τέλειος), [in LXX: [[exodus 29 9|Exo.29:9]], [[leviticus 4 5|Lev.4:5]], al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), [[2-samuel 22 26|2Ki.22:26]], al. (תָּמַם), Wis.4:13, al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;] 1. bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil: [[john 4 34|Jhn.4:34]], [[acts 20 24|Act.20:24]]; of time, [[luke 2 43|Luk.2:43]], [[john 5 36|Jhn.5:36 17:4]]; pass., ἡ γραφή, [[john 19 28|Jhn.19:28.]] 2. to bring to maturity or completeness, to complete, perfect; (a) of things: [[hebrews 7 19|Heb.7:19]], [[james 2 22|Jas.2:22]], [[1-john 2 5|1Jn.2:5]] [[john 4 12|Jn 4:12]] [[john 4 17|Jn 4:17]] : (b) of persons, in ethical and spiritual sense: [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10 9:9 10:1, 14]]; pass., [[luke 13 32|Luk.13:32]], [[john 17 23|Jhn.17:23]], [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12]], [[hebrews 5 9|Heb.5:9 7:28 11:40 12:23]], [[1-john 4 18|1Jn.4:18]] (for a different view of the meaning in [[hebrews 2 10|Heb.2:10]], al., see Rendall, in l).† (AS)
τελείως (τέλειος), adv., [in LXX: Jdth.11:6, 2Ma.12:42, 3Ma.3:26 3Mac 7:22, R* ;] completely, perfectly: [[1-peter 1 13|1Pe.1:13.]]† (AS)
τελείωσις, -εως, ἡ (τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, [[exodus 29 22|Exo.29:22]], al. ;] fulfilment, completion, perfection: [[luke 1 45|Luk.1:45]], [[hebrews 7 11|Heb.7:11]].† (AS)
τελειωτής, -οῦ, ὁ (τελειόω), a consummator, finisher: [[hebrews 12 2|Heb.12:2]] (nowhere else).† (AS)

τελεσφορέω, -ῶ (τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;] (a) of plants, to bring fruit to perfection (Theophr.): [[luke 8 14|Luk.8:14]] (b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).† (AS)

τελευτάω, -ῶ (τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] 1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.). 2. Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die (Hdt., al.): [[matthew 2 19|Mat.2:19 9:18 22:25]], [[mark 9 48|Mrk.9:48]], [[luke 7 2|Luk.7:2]], [[john 11 39|Jhn.11:39]], [[acts 2 29|Act.2:29 7:15]], [[hebrews 11 22|Heb.11:22]]; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, [[exodus 21 17|Exo.21:17]]), [[matthew 15 4|Mat.15:4]], [[mark 7 10|Mrk.7:10]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

τελευτή, -ῆς, ἡ (τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;] 1. a finishing. 2. an end: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): [[matthew 2 15|Mat.2:15.]]† (AS)

τελέω, -ῶ (τέλος), [in LXX for כָּלָה, pi., etc. ;] 1. to bring to an end, complete, finish: τ. δρόμον, [[2-timothy 4 7|2Ti.4:7;]] τ. λόγους, [[matthew 7 28|Mat.7:28 19:1 26:1]]; τ. παραβολάς, [[matthew 13 53|Mat.13:53;]] τ. πόλεις, [[matthew 10 23|Mat.10:23;]] pass., [[revelation 15 8|Rev.15:8 20:3, 5 20:7]]; with ptcp., [[matthew 11 1|Mat.11:1.]] 2. to execute, perform, complete, fulfil: [[luke 2 39|Luk.2:39]], [[acts 13 29|Act.13:29]], [[romans 2 27|Rom.2:27]], [[2-corinthians 12 9|2Co.12:9]], [[galatians 5 16|Gal.5:16]], [[james 2 8|Jas.2:8]], [[revelation 11 7|Rev.11:7]]; pass., [[luke 12 50|Luk.12:50 18:31 22:37]], [[john 19 28|Jhn.19:28, 30]], [[revelation 10 7|Rev.10:7 15:1 17:17]]. 3. to pay (frequently in cl.): [[matthew 17 24|Mat.17:24]], [[romans 13 6|Rom.13:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-τελέω).† (AS)

τέλος, -ους, τό [in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;] 1. end: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), [[luke 1 33|Luk.1:33]], [[1-corinthians 10 11|1Co.10:11]], [[2-corinthians 3 13|2Co.3:13]], [[1-peter 4 7|1Pe.4:7]]; by meton., of one who makes an end, [[romans 10 4|Rom.10:4;]] ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, [[1-corinthians 1 8|1Co.1:8]], [[2-corinthians 1 13|2Co.1:13]], [[hebrews 3 14|Heb.3:14 6:11]], [[revelation 2 26|Rev.2:26]]; εἰς τ., to or at the end, [[matthew 10 22|Mat.10:22]], [[mark 13 13|Mrk.13:13]], [[luke 18 5|Luk.18:5]], [[john 13 1|Jhn.13:1]] (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, [[luke 22 37|Luk.22:37;]] adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, [[1-peter 3 8|1Pe.3:8;]] of the last in a series, [[revelation 21 6|Rev.21:6 22:13]]; of the issue, fate or destiny, [[matthew 26 58|Mat.26:58;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[romans 6 21|Rom.6:21]], al.; with genitive of person(s), [[2-corinthians 11 13|2Co.11:13]], al.; of the aim or purpose, [[1-timothy 1 5|1Ti.1:5.]] 2. toll, custom, revenue: [[romans 13 7|Rom.13:7;]] pl., as most usually, [[matthew 17 25|Mat.17:25]] (AS)

τελώνης, -ου, ὁ (τέλος, ὠνέομαι) 1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus). 2. A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): [[matthew 5 46|Mat.5:46 10:3]], [[luke 3 12|Luk.3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13]]; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, [[matthew 9 10|Mat.9:10-11 11:19]], [[mark 2 15|Mrk.2:15-16]], [[luke 5 30|Luk.5:30 7:34 15:1]]; τ. κ. πόρναι, [[matthew 21 31|Mat.21:31-32;]] ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., [[matthew 18 17|Mat.18:17]] (cf. DB, iv, 172; ext., 394 f.; MM, xxiv).† (AS)
τελώνιον, -ου, τό (τελώνης), a custom house (so in MGr.), tollhouse, place of toll: [[matthew 9 9|Mat.9:9]], [[mark 2 14|Mrk.2:14]], [[luke 5 27|Luk.5:27]].† (AS)
τέρας, -ατος, τό [in LXX chiefly for מוֹפֵת ;] a wonder, marvel: in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, [[matthew 24 24|Mat.24:24]], al. (see: σημεῖον) (AS)
Τέρτιος, -ου, ὁ Tertius: [[romans 16 22|Rom.16:22.]]† (AS)
Τέρτυλλος, -ου, ό Tertullus: [[acts 2 1|Act.2:1-2.]]† (AS)

τεσσεράκοντα (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 45 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl., forty: [[matthew 4 2|Mat.4:2]], [[mark 1 13|Mrk.1:13]], [[luke 4 2|Luk.4:2]], [[john 2 20|Jhn.2:20]], [[acts 1 3|Act.1:3]], al (AS)
τεσσερακονταετίς (Τ, -έτης; Rec. τεσσαρ-, see supr.), -ές of forty years, forty years old: [[acts 7 23|Act.7:23 13:18]].† (AS)

τέσσαρες (and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων, four: [[matthew 24 31|Mat.24:31]], [[mark 2 3|Mrk.2:3]], [[luke 2 37|Luk.2:37]], [[john 11 17|Jhn.11:17 19:23]], [[acts 10 11|Act.10:11]], [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4]], 6, al (AS)
τεσσαρεσ-και-δέκατος, -η, -ον fourteenth: [[acts 27 27|Act.27:27, 33]].† (AS)
τεταρταῖος, -α, -ον (τέταρτος), [in LXX: [[2-samuel 3 4|2Ki.3:4]] A (רְבִיעִי) * ;] of or on the fourth day: τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, [[john 11 39|Jhn.11:39.]]† (AS)
τέταρτος, -η, -ον [in LXX chiefly for רְבִיעִי ;] fourth: [[matthew 14 25|Mat.14:25]], [[mark 6 48|Mrk.6:48]], [[acts 10 30|Act.10:30]], [[revelation 4 7|Rev.4:7 6:7-8 8:12 16:8 21:19]].† (AS)
τετράγωνος, -ον (τετρα-, see supr., + γωνία), [in LXX for רָבַע and cogn. forms ;] square: [[revelation 21 16|Rev.21:16]] (Hdt., Plat., al.).† (AS)
τετράδιον, ου, τό a quarternion, a group of four: στρατιωτῶν, [[acts 12 4|Act.12:4]] (Philo). (AS)
τετρακισ-χίλιοι, -αι, -α four thousand: [[matthew 15 38|Mat.15:38 16:10]], [[mark 8 9|Mrk.8:9, 20]], [[acts 21 38|Act.21:38]].† (AS)
τετρακόσιοι, -αι, -α, four hundred: [[acts 5 36|Act.5:36 7:6]]" (LXX) 13:20, [[galatians 3 17|Gal.3:17]].† (AS)

τετράμηνος, -ον [in LXX (neut.): [[judges 19 2|Jdg.19:2]] A [[judges 20 47|Jdg.20:47]] A (עַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים ) * ;] of four months, four months; as subst., τ. (sc. ὥρα, but neut. in Rec.), [[john 4 35|Jhn.4:35]] (Thuc., al.).† (AS)

τεφρόω, -ῶ (τέφρα, ashes; Wis.2:3, al.), to burn to ashes: [[2-peter 2 6|2Pe.2:6.]]† (AS)

τεχνίτης, -ου, ὁ (τέχνη), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;] a craftsman, artificer: [[acts 19 24|Act.19:24, 38]], [[revelation 18 22|Rev.18:22]]; of God (Wis.13:1), [[hebrews 11 10|Heb.11:10]].† SYN.: δημιουργός, which see, and cf. Tr., Syn., § cv (AS)
τήκω [in LXX for מָסַס ni., מָקַק ni., מוּג ni., etc. ;] trans., to melt, melt down; pass., to melt, melt away: [[2-peter 3 12|2Pe.3:12.]]† (AS)
τηλαυγῶς adv. (τῆλε, afar, + αὐγή, radiance), poët. and in late prose, at a distance clearly: [[mark 8 25|Mrk.8:25]] (W, mg., δηλαυγῶς).† (AS)

Τιβέριος, -ου, ὁ, the Emperor Tiberius: [[luke 3 1|Luk.3:1.]]† (AS)

τίθημι, [in LXX for שִׁית ,נתן ,שׂוּם, etc. ;] 1. causative of κεῖμαι, (a) to place, lay, set: [[luke 6 48|Luk.6:48]], [[romans 9 33|Rom.9:33]], al.; of laying the dead to rest, [[mark 15 47|Mrk.15:47]], [[luke 23 55|Luk.23:55]], [[john 11 34|Jhn.11:34]], [[acts 7 16|Act.7:16]], al.; before ἐπί, with genitive, [[luke 8 16|Luk.8:16]], [[john 19 19|Jhn.19:19]], al.; id. with accusative, [[mark 4 21|Mrk.4:21]], [[2-corinthians 3 13|2Co.3:13]], al.; ὑπό, [[matthew 5 15|Mat.5:15]], al.; παρά, [[acts 4 35|Act.4:35, 37]]. Mid., to have put or placed, to place for oneself: of putting in prison, [[acts 4 3|Act.4:3, 5:18, 25]], al.; of giving counsel, βουλήν, Act.27:12; of laying up in one's heart, [[luke 1 66|Luk.1:66 21:14]] ( [[1-samuel 21 12|1Ki.21:12]]); (b) to put down, lay down: of bending the knees, τ. γόνατα, to kneel, [[mark 15 19|Mrk.15:19]], [[acts 7 60|Act.7:60]], al.; of putting off garments, [[john 13 4|Jhn.13:4;]] of laying down life, τ. ψυχήν, [[john 10 11|Jhn.10:11, 15 17, 18 13:37, 38 15:13]], [[1-john 3 16|1Jn.3:16]]; of laying by money, παρ ̓ ἑαυτῷ, [[1-corinthians 16 2|1Co.16:2;]] of setting on food, [[john 2 10|Jhn.2:10;]] metaphorically, of setting forth an idea in symbolism, [[mark 4 30|Mrk.4:30.]] 2. to set, fix, establish: ὑπόδειγμα, [[2-peter 2 6|2Pe.2:6.]] 3. to make, appoint: [[matthew 22 44|Mat.22:44]], [[mark 12 36|Mrk.12:36]], [[luke 20 43|Luk.20:43]], [[acts 2 35|Act.2:35]], [[romans 4 17|Rom.4:17]], al. Mid., to make, set or appoint for oneself: [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28]], [[1-corinthians 12 28|1Co.12:28]], [[1-thessalonians 5 9|1Th.5:9]], [[1-timothy 1 12|1Ti.1:12]], al.; before ἵνα, [[john 15 16|Jhn.15:16]] (cf . ἀνα-, προσ-ανα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἀντι-δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-τίθημι). (AS)

τίκτω [in LXX chiefly for יָלַד ;] prop., of parents, to beget, bring forth, but esp. the latter, and so always in NT: absol., [[luke 1 57|Luk.1:57 2:6]], [[john 16 21|Jhn.16:21]], [[galatians 4 27|Gal.4:27]]" (LXX) (see M, Pr., 127), [[revelation 12 2|Rev.12:2]], 4; υἱόν, [[matthew 1 21|Mat.1:21, 23 1:25]] [[luke 1 31|Luk.1:31 2:7]], [[revelation 12 5|Rev.12:5, 13]]; pass., [[matthew 2 2|Mat.2:2]], [[luke 2 11|Luk.2:11]]. Metaphorical, of the earth, βοτάνην, [[hebrews 6 7|Heb.6:7]] (Æsch., al.); of lust, ἁμαρτίαν, [[james 1 15|Jas.1:15.]]† (AS)
τίλλω [in LXX: [[esther 9 3|Est.9:3]], [[isaiah 18 7|Isa.18:7]], Dan LXX 7:4 (מָרַט) * ;] to pluck, pluck off: στάχυας, [[matthew 12 1|Mat.12:1]], [[mark 2 23|Mrk.2:23]], [[luke 6 1|Luk.6:1]].† (AS)
Τιμαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. טִימַי (?), see Zorell, see word), Timæus: [[mark 10 46|Mrk.10:46.]]† (AS)

τιμάω, -ῶ (τιμή), [in LXX for כָּבַד pi., עָרַךְ hi., etc. ;] 1. to fix the value, price: with accusative of person(s), of Christ, [[matthew 27 9|Mat.27:9]] (LXX). 2. to honour: with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 15 4|Mat.15:4]] (LXX), [[matthew 15 5|Mat.15:5]], 8" (LXX) [[matthew 19 19|Mat.19:19]] (LXX), [[mark 7 6|Mrk.7:6, 10 10:19]], [[luke 18 28|Luk.18:28]]" (LXX), [[john 5 23|Jhn.5:23 8:49 12:26]], [[ephesians 6 2|Eph.6:2]]" (LXX), [[1-timothy 5 3|1Ti.5:3]], [[1-peter 2 17|1Pe.2:17]]; πολλαῖς τιμαῖς, [[acts 28 10|Act.28:10.]]† (AS)

τιμή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX for עֵרֶךְ, יְקָר, etc. ;] a valuing, hence, objectively; 1. a price paid or received: with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 27 9|Mat.27:9;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[acts 5 2|Act.5:2-3;]] pl., [[acts 4 34|Act.4:34 19:19]]; τ. αἵματος, [[matthew 27 6|Mat.27:6;]] ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς, [[1-corinthians 6 20|1Co.6:20 7:23]]; ὠνεῖσθαι τιμῆς ἀργυρίου, [[acts 7 16|Act.7:16.]] 2. esteem, honour: [[romans 12 10|Rom.12:10 13:7]], [[1-corinthians 12 23|1Co.12:23]], [[1-timothy 5 17|1Ti.5:17 6:1]], [[hebrews 5 4|Heb.5:4]], [[1-peter 2 7|1Pe.2:7]] (R, txt., preciousness, cf. Hort, in l), [[1-peter 3 7|1Pe.3:7;]] τ. διδόναι, [[1-corinthians 12 24|1Co.12:24;]] ἔχειν, [[john 4 44|Jhn.4:44]], [[hebrews 3 3|Heb.3:3]]; τ. καὶ δόξα (δ. κ. τ.), [[romans 2 7|Rom.2:7, 10]], [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], [[hebrews 2 7|Heb.2:7]]" (LXX), [[hebrews 2 9|Heb.2:9]], [[1-peter 1 7|1Pe.1:7]], [[2-peter 1 17|2Pe.1:17]], [[revelation 4 9|Rev.4:9, 11 5:12-13 7:12 21:26]]; τ. καὶ κράτος, [[1-timothy 6 16|1Ti.6:16;]] εἰς τ., [[romans 9 21|Rom.9:21]], [[2-timothy 2 20|2Ti.2:20-21]]; ἐν τ., [[colossians 2 23|Col.2:23;]] [[1-thessalonians 4 4|1Th.4:4]]; by meton., of marks of honour, [[acts 28 10|Act.28:10.]]† (AS)

τίμιος, -α, -ον (τιμή), [in LXX chiefly for יָקָר ;] valued, hence, (a) precious, costly, highly valued: primarily, of money value, λίθος, [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16 21:19]]; pl., [[1-corinthians 3 12|1Co.3:12;]] compar., -ώτεφος, [[1-peter 1 7|1Pe.1:7]], Rec.; superl., -ώτατος, [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12 21:11]]; in extended sense, καρπός, [[james 5 7|Jas.5:7;]] αἷμα, [[1-peter 1 19|1Pe.1:19;]] ἐπαγγέλματα, [[2-peter 1 4|2Pe.1:4;]] (b) held in honour, honoured, esteemed worthy: with dative, [[acts 5 34|Act.5:34;]] ὁ γάμος, [[hebrews 13 4|Heb.13:4;]] ψυχή, [[acts 20 24|Act.20:24]] (where τ. is pleonastic, see Page, in l).† (AS)
τιμιότης, -ητος, ἡ (τίμιος), preciousness, worth: [[revelation 18 19|Rev.18:19]] (cf. Hort on τιμή, [[1-peter 2 7|1Pe.2:7]]).† (AS)
Τιμόθεος, -ου, ὁ Timothy: [[acts 17 14|Act.17:14-15 18:5]], [[romans 16 21|Rom.16:21]], al. (AS)
Τίμων, -ωνος, ὁ Timon: [[acts 6 5|Act.6:5.]]† (AS)

τιμωρέω, -ῶ (τιμή + οὖρος, a guardian) [in LXX: [[ezekiel 5 17|Eze.5:17 14:15]] (שָׁכֹל pi), Wis.12:20 18:8, al. ;] 1. to help. 2. to avenge; mid., to avenge oneself on, punish (Hdt., Eur., al): act, in this sense, [[acts 22 5|Act.22:5 26:11]] (see MM, xxiv).† (AS)

τιμωρία, -ας, ἡ (τιμωρέω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 24 22|Pro.24:22]] (פִּיד), etc. ;] 1. help, assistance. 2. vengeance, punishment: [[hebrews 10 29|Heb.10:29.]]† SYN.: κόλασις, which see, and cf. MM, xxiv (AS)
τίνω [in LXX: [[proverbs 27 12|Pro.27:12]] (τ. ζημίαν, for עָנַשׁ ni.), etc. ;] to pay: t. δίκην (cf. Pr, l.with), to pay penalty, [[2-thessalonians 1 9|2Th.1:9]] (see M, Th., in l).† (AS)
